thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: Elevated 5xx and gateway timeouts detected for traffic to /v1/generate across gateway-prod (region: us-west). 5xx spike started ~4280012300, current error rate ~18% over 5m window. Paging oncall.

alice (oncall): on it. joining. any visible deploys in last 30m?

deploy-bot: recent deploys: gateway-config v2026.03.14-rc4 at 4280009800 -> route/weight changes for backend pool 'gen-pool-b'.

bob (eng-sre): I see the spike in Grafana. 99th latency up, and a big cluster of 502/504 from edge-proxy. Looks like retries are amplifying. TLDR: retries + unhealthy downstream = retry storms.

carlos (eng-runtime): attaching logs from one edge proxy:
```
[2026-03-15T18:45:23Z] GET /v1/generate -> 502 upstream connect error, connection refused
[2026-03-15T18:45:23Z] retried 3 times -> upstream reset
```
Seems route to gen-pool-b returning connection resets. healthcheck flapping?

dana (infra): healthchecks show gen-pool-b hosts flapping UNHEALTHY <-> HEALTHY with ~30s intervals. prob a mis-tuned HC after weight change.

alice (oncall): customers? frank, CS, anything flagged?

frank (cs): a few enterprise customers flagged errors from mobile apps. severity: degraded experience for sync generation endpoints. Not yet escalated externally but may be by SRE.

bob (eng-sre): immediate mitigations: 1) disable automated retries at gateway for /v1/generate 2) remove weight from gen-pool-b (drain) 3) raise circuit-breaker thresholds so we don't cascade. I'll propose commands.

alice (oncall): do it. I'll coordinate with eng-runtime for config changes and infra for drain.

carlos (eng-runtime): preparing quick patch to envoy retry config. Patch snippet to set num_retries: 0 for route match /v1/generate.
```
# envoy xds patch (quick)
route:
  match: { prefix: "/v1/generate" }
  retry_policy: { num_retries: 0 }
```
Applying via config manager in 30s.

bob (eng-sre): also recommend disabling global automatic retry shadowing in front of gateway (we saw N->1 amplification). command I ran in staging earlier:
```
redwoodctl routing update --route "/v1/generate" --set retry_policy.num_retries=0
```

deploy-bot: config change applied to gateway-prod (change id gc-4280012360) — rollback rule in place.

alice (oncall): confirmed gateway config change applied. watching error rate.

(2m pass)

alice (oncall): error rate dropped from 18% -> 9% after disabling retries. still above baseline (~1-2%).

dana (infra): I've started draining gen-pool-b and rebalancing to gen-pool-a. K8s commands:
```
kubectl cordon gen-pool-b-node-17
kubectl drain gen-pool-b-node-17 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data
```

bob (eng-sre): good. Also we should check LB circuit breaker settings. current max_connections for gen-pool-b was low (100). bump to 500 to avoid immediate ejects while healthchecks stabilize.

carlos (eng-runtime): bump applied to envoy cluster config (temp):
```
cluster: gen-pool-b
circuit_breakers:
  thresholds:
    - max_connections: 500
      max_retries: 0
```

alice (oncall): monitoring. any customer-impacted requests that were in-flight and retried? we should inform CS.

frank (cs): will prepare a brief for customers: root cause suspected config weight + healthcheck sensitivity caused host flapping, amplified by retries. advising engineers are mitigating. ETA for full recovery?

bob (eng-sre): if drains and retry disable hold, we should be back to baseline in ~10-15m. will keep this thread updated. also creating follow-up ticket to revert config change with proper HC thresholds and safe rollouts.

erin (prod-pm): note for postmortem: why did config change deploy without canary? need rollout policy tweaks. adding to PM backlog.

(10m pass)

alice (oncall): error rate now 1.5% — near baseline. marking incident as mitigated. keeping page open for 60m for monitoring.

incident-bot: INCIDENT UPDATE: mitigated -> monitoring. severity reduced to P2. Oncall: alice. Incident lead: bob.

bob (eng-sre): next actions (post-incident): - revert temporary CB bump after host stabilization - fix healthcheck thresholds for gen-pool-b - add canary & automated preflight for route weight changes - add a replay test for retry amplification.

carlos (eng-runtime): logging the envoy config diffs and the applied patch ids: gc-4280012360 (retry-disable), cbbump-4280012385.

frank (cs): I'll send an internal customer update template to stakeholders. prepping external note only if more reports come in.

dana (infra): gen-pool-b nodes show steady healthy now. leaving cordon for 10m then uncordon.

alice (oncall): thanks everyone. closing live remediation window. will open a postmortem thread and assign owners.

bob (eng-sre): adding links: Grafana error-rate panel: https://grafana.redwood/prod/d/1234/edge-errors?from=4280012000&to=4280013000

alice (oncall): reaction :thumbsup: Great work. remember to include the deploy id and exact config diff in the PM.

incident-bot: Incident closed for live mitigation. Postmortem thread: will be created under #postmortems with tag pm-4280012345.
